title: {Syn} GPT Showed Next-Token Prediction Could Scale
content:
The GPT line demonstrated that autoregressive next-token prediction could produce broadly useful language models when scaled with data and compute.

The recipe is conceptually simple but powerful: train on large text corpora, then adapt behavior through prompting, fine-tuning, or preference optimization.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
